description: This Java class `ProgressiveLoanInterestRefundServiceImpl` is a service implementation for handling interest refunds in a loan management system. It deals with reprocessing loan transactions, recalculating interest, and regenerating repayment schedules based on progressive loan interest strategies.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanInterestRefundServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class that implements logic for refunding interest on progressive loans, including recomputation of interest schedules based on transaction data.

methods.name: simulateRepaymentForDisbursements
methods.description: Simulates loan transactions for disbursements and adjusts refund amounts accordingly.

methods.name: recalculateTotalInterest
methods.description: Recalculates total interest after transaction adjustments, potentially regenerating the repayment schedule for progressive loans.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the service can handle a particular loan based on its transaction processing strategy.

methods.name: isTransactionNeededForInterestRefundCalculations
methods.description: Determines whether a transaction needs to be considered for interest refund calculations.

methods.name: totalInterestByTransactions
methods.description: Calculates the total interest from a list of transactions for a specific loan and date, considering interest refund strategies.
